templates.title: Build the case and report its errors
templates.desc: Compiles the case and tables what the Fortran compiler said, so a model that will not build is found before anything is run.

templates.title: Fault ride through over fault durations
templates.desc: For each fault duration: writes the fault component’s timing, runs the EMT simulation and tables the voltage dip and the machine speed nadir, with every run on one graph.

templates.title: Sweep one parameter
templates.desc: Steps one component parameter through a range, runs the case at each value and tables what a channel did, with a 2D graph of the result against the parameter.

templates.title: Harmonics and THD from an EMT run
templates.desc: Runs the case, takes the harmonic spectrum of a voltage once it has settled, and tables the THD, the worst harmonic and every order, with a bar chart of the spectrum.

templates.title: Critical clearing time
templates.desc: Halves the gap to find the longest fault the case rides through: for each try the fault duration is written, the case is run and the machine speed decides pass or fail.

templates.title: Run every network arrangement
templates.desc: Puts each layer of the case in turn and leaves the others out, runs the EMT simulation for each and tables what a channel did: one case, every arrangement.

templates.title: Initialise once, then branch
templates.desc: Runs the case to a settled state and saves a snapshot, then starts each fault from it instead of simulating the start-up again every time.

templates.title: A run for each parameter set
templates.desc: Switches the case to each of its global substitution sets in turn and runs it, so one model covers every parameter set it was built with.

templates.title: Run several cases at once
templates.desc: Puts cases into a simulation set and runs them several at a time. This is where a PSCAD study gets real parallelism: four at a time finish in about the time of one.

templates.title: Damping of a ringdown
templates.desc: Disturbs the case, measures the damping ratio and frequency of the oscillation that follows, and fails the pass when it is growing: a control interaction check.
